trust_decision.summary: CRUDComponent::add decides that a client may not choose the primary key of a new record; at the pinned commit it strips 'id' from the controller $params array instead of from the request body that is actually patched into the entity.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'mass assignment of record identifiers during object creation'; every controller add() delegates to CRUDComponent::add, and the stale unset($params['id']) sits right there.

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /{controller}/add for every controller using $this->CRUD->add (e.g. src/Controller/UsersController.php:125, src/Controller/RolesController.php:35, src/Controller/LocalToolsController.php:167, plugins/Tags/src/Controller/TagsController.php:32)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the CRUD edit route (O8): the advisory says 'during object creation', and REST clients routinely echo the record id back in edit bodies, so an edit-side id is easy to call expected and out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate fields that new-record creation still has to accept: 'uuid' and 'created' are whitelisted on new entities via _accessibleOnNew, and nested 'individual' data on user creation is handled by captureIndividual. A fix that rejects every identifier-like key, or that drops accessibleFields, would break supplying a uuid for broods, sharing groups and mailing lists, or creating a user together with a new individual.

O6_input_shapes: top-level 'id' key in the POST/JSON body (the only shape the fix handles; fix.diff:22-24)

O7_producer.where: src/Controller/Component/CRUDComponent.php:731-750 (__massageInput builds the patch input from request->getData() plus params['override'])

O8_uncovered_routes.route: CRUDComponent::edit patches request-body data (including any 'id') into the loaded entity and never strips the primary key; reaches the same patchEntity/save sink for entities with no _accessible map (Role, User, LocalTool, UserSetting, PermissionLimitation, EnumerationCollection).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Edit, not creation: the advisory is scoped to object creation, and an id in an edit body is normally just the client echoing the record back.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, about 390 lines below the fix site

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Entity with no _accessible map, so 'id' stays mass-assignable on any patch that does not use the CRUD strip (e.g. a Roles-specific add or import path).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Several entities (Role, User, LocalTool, UserSetting) were hand-written without the baked 'id' => false map, while Organisation, Individual and others have it (src/Model/Entity/Organisation.php:10-14).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Bulk importer marshals rows with newEntities/patchEntity and accessibleFields from _accessibleOnNew; for tables whose entity leaves id accessible, a row 'id' is persisted.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Second creation implementation in another package (Command), reusing the same accessibleFields idiom but not the CRUD strip; a maintainer would have assumed entity rules cover it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Hand-rolled add that patches request->getData() directly into newEmptyEntity without CRUDComponent.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Currently protected only because Alignment sets 'id' => false (src/Model/Entity/Alignment.php:10-13); a planted copy for an entity without that map would be a natural, distant sibling.

O9_family: mass assignment / improper input filtering of primary key on create (CWE-20 / CWE-915)

O10_build.project_tests: tests/TestCase/Api/* API tests, including tests/TestCase/Api/Users/AddUserApiTest.php and per-model Add*/Edit* API tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Move the unset to the massaged request input in CRUDComponent::add (the published fix), stopping there without touching edit or entity-level _accessible maps.

out_of_scope_notes: CRUDComponent::edit takes 'id' from the request body; whether Cake's _update then targets the new primary key (another row) was not checked; it may be a separate, more serious issue.
unverified: That CakePHP 4 EntityTrait defaults $_accessible to ['*' => true]; vendor/ is not in the pinned tree, so 'id' being assignable on Role/User/LocalTool/etc. rests on framework knowledge.
present_in_latest for the O8 route: no latest release given.
Whether the fix diff adds tests: the diff contains only the CRUDComponent change, so regression_tests_in_pinned_commit does not apply.
O1 counts the 15 CRUD->add call sites found by grep; some may be gated by ACL to admins.
